name: FollowEval
description: FollowEval is a multi-dimensional benchmark designed to assess the instruction-following capabilities of large language models across five critical dimensions: string manipulation, commonsense reasoning, logical reasoning, spatial reasoning, and response constraints. It includes human-crafted test examples in both English and Chinese, with each example evaluating multiple dimensions to present a sufficient challenge.
reputation: A specialized instruction-following benchmark that has seen some use in LLM evaluation, but it is not among the most widely standardized leaderboards.
notes: Includes bilingual human-crafted examples; evaluates multiple instruction-following dimensions simultaneously.
